meta.purpose: Translate marked SPM-style paper evidence into curriculum and diagnostic nodes.

upload_analysis_pipeline: backtrack prerequisites only where evidence supports it
confidence_guardrails: Teacher ticks/crosses and awarded marks establish performance evidence but do not by themselves prove root cause.
If teacher annotations explicitly identify an error type, treat them as high-value evidence but preserve raw annotation separately.
If question or handwriting is unreadable, request/flag verification rather than infer a weakness.
For essay total marks without rubric annotations, generate dimension hypotheses with lower confidence instead of a definitive diagnosis.
Multiple independent examples of the same underlying skill error are required before persistent weakness status.
